name: John
bio: John, son of Zebedee, was mending fishing nets with his father and brother James when Jesus called the two brothers to follow him; they immediately left the boat and their father to do so (Matthew 4:21-22). His place among Jesus's closest disciples, and his later authorship of a Gospel, three letters, and Revelation, are told in detail in the chapters and books ahead. He is a different figure from John the Baptist. He, along with Peter and his brother James, was taken by Jesus up a mountain to witness his transfiguration with Moses and Elijah (Matthew 17:1-8). On the way to Jerusalem, his mother asked Jesus that he and his brother James sit at Jesus's right and left in his kingdom; Jesus told them they would share his suffering, though such honors were the Father's to grant (Matthew 20:20-23).
